policy: A 0.4 release requires a 0.4 server. Old devices remain compatible with capability-free backends; mixed-version serve must refuse E_GENERATION without changing the prepared release/store.

canonical_backend.changes: Exactly eight site/reason string changes (two sites in programs and two in schema.operations); read spelling adds first 10 and explanations add selected key, result shape and selection reason. No runtime IR/table shape changes in this control.

fix: Shared SQLite Store::prepare no longer creates _effect_keys. Tx::effect_once creates it inside the emitting transaction on first use. Permanent keys, replay suppression, deduplication and write metering stay unchanged.

failed_attempts.reason: New physical-byte assertions took native snapshots before successful legacy job-column migration; first mixed-version serve also established release store symlink.
Release byte snapshot included successful matching server WAL left by SIGTERM; old serve recovered/checkpointed it.
Stored Rust schema field order differs from /schema canonical key order; all behavioral and release/store preservation checks passed.

regression_scope: Initial current open on real 0.2.33 store adds no _effect_keys; failed adoption on that opened store preserves raw SQLite bytes and every logical row/table. Current engine future-capability refusal adds no once-key table and preserves raw bytes. Failed first emissions roll back table creation under outbox, heap, and write-meter failures.
